reviews.title: App Updates removed 60fps exports
reviews.text:
(May 2026 Edit)

I’ve used this app for over 10 years. I’ve loved it, but the newest updates have made the video quality worse!

I’ve had the feature to export my snippets in 60 fps for years. It used to be a toggle. 

Now that toggle has been removed not only for 4K exports (Paying for Pro) but also for 1080p exports. 

I want my memories to last by having the best quality videos by recording everything in 4K 60fps. But unfortunately 2025/2026 projects will look WORSE because the devs won’t fix this. 

I’ve tried to work with support on this many times but they haven’t been helpful. 

Maybe it’s time to try another app. 

———————————————-


I love this app! I used it most of 2013 and compiled my first year of snippets together. I love going back and watching it again and again. I love most the idea of recording 1 second to help me reflect later, rather than losing the opportunity to enjoy the moment at hand. Thank you!

reviews.title: great app, terrible customer service
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for five years and have loved it, but it stopped working randomly this January. I tried everything to troubleshoot the issue, but nothing worked. I contacted customer support but was left without a solution for several weeks and was told over and over to try the same troubleshooting measures. Below is the message I sent to the team expressing my frustration.

Hi, I recently traded in my iPhone 12 for a newer iPhone, and the problem seems to have resolved itself. I would imagine the app was having a compatibility issue with the iPhone 12. Although the problem resolved itself, I have to admit I was extremely frustrated with the lack of help that I received from your team in troubleshooting this issue. I would go several days without a response and, when I did get a response, I would be asked to do over the same troubleshooting measures I had already done. This went on for a few weeks and was incredibly frustrating. It’s a wonderful app, but I would strongly suggest reworking your customer support methods to better ensure customer satisfaction. I appreciate your time.

Like I said, this app is a wonderful tool, but is pretty much useless if you run into any tech issue as the support team is hard to reach and largely unhelpful.
